about.title: About Rose Silvers
about.intro: Founded on the principle that elegance should be accessible and timeless, Rose Silvers is a premium sterling silver jewelry brand dedicated to crafting exquisite pieces that celebrate individuality and style.
about.craftsmanshipText: Every piece in our collection is meticulously crafted by skilled artisans using high-quality 925 sterling silver. We believe in the beauty of details, ensuring that each ring, necklace, and bracelet meets our rigorous standards of quality.
about.missionText: Our mission is to provide you with jewelry that not only enhances your everyday look but also becomes a cherished part of your personal story. We are committed to sustainable practices and ethical sourcing in all our creations.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Have a question or need assistance? We're here to help. Fill out the form below and our team will get back to you within 24 hours.
contact.name: Name

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.processingText: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or holidays. If we are experiencing a high volume of orders, shipments may be delayed by a few days.
shipping.ratesText: Shipping charges for your order will be calculated and displayed at checkout.
shipping.internationalText: We currently offer international shipping to select countries. Please note that customs duties and taxes may apply and are the responsibility of the customer.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.policyText: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If for any reason you are not happy with your order, we accept returns within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange.
returns.cond1: Items must be unworn, unused, and in their original packaging.
returns.cond2: Custom or engraved pieces are final sale and cannot be returned.
returns.howText: To initiate a return, please visit our Contact page and provide your order number. We will provide you with a prepaid return shipping label and instructions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.infoText: We collect information that you provide directly to us when you create an account, make a purchase, sign up for our newsletter, or communicate with us. This may include your name, email address, shipping address, and payment information.
privacy.useText: We use the information we collect to process your orders, communicate with you about your purchases, and send you promotional materials if you have opted in to receive them.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. Your payment details are processed securely through Shopify and are never stored on our servers.
